text: 东兴证券公告，公司收到证监会批复，核准中金公司吸收合并东兴证券及信达证券。为确保A股异议股东现金选择权实施，公司A股股票自2026年9月15日开市起连续停牌，直至终止上市，不再复牌。2026年9月14日为最后一个交易日。
text_en: Dongxing Securities announced that it received CSRC approval for CICC to absorb and merge Dongxing Securities and Cinda Securities via share exchange. To ensure implementation of the cash option for A-share dissenting shareholders, the company's A-shares will be suspended continuously from market open on September 15, 2026, until delisting, with no resumption. September 14, 2026 will be the last trading day.
